ctx.x: Well, we had Willie Warner. Yeah. And Frank Gwynn. That old one. Zed. Zed. Kaiser. Kaiser. Kaiser.
I heard Fess talk about Zed a lot. Yeah. And Manuel Mineta.
Did you ever play with Manuel Mineta? Oh, yeah. We played in Storerville, one or two years.
